question: A large marble building in Kolkata, built by the British whose design echoes the Taj Mahal is _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Victoria Memorial**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **White Makrana marble** was used to construct the** Victoria Memorial**.
 
• With its dome, four subsidiary, octagonal-domed chattris, towering portals, terrace, and domed corner towers, it resembles the Taj Mahal in design.
 
• **The Victoria Memorial** is a magnificent marble structure in Kolkata's central business district that was constructed between 1906 and 1921.
 
• It is the world's largest royal monument and is now a museum under the supervision of the Ministry of Culture. It is dedicated to the memory of Queen Victoria.
 
• The memorial is located on the Maidan and is one of Kolkata's most iconic monuments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Writers' Buildings** is the official administrative building of West Bengal's state government in Kolkata, India.
 
• **St. Paul's Church **is a Church of North India (CNI) cathedral in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, dedicated to Paul the Apostle and known for its Gothic architecture.
 
• **The Fort William** is located in Hastings, Calcutta (Kolkata). It was constructed during the British India Bengal Presidency's early years.
